supersedes: Recommendation to use v2 item scores and target-distance as primary evidence of prompt simulation performance
why: Modified scoring anchors, observation unit, aggregation and evaluator were not externally validated.
Equal costs between ordinal grades and target distance are research design choices, not established clinical fidelity metrics.
Agreement between an expert and an LLM using the same new rubric is rater agreement, not sufficient construct validation.
allowed_use: Exploratory development checks and arithmetic demonstrations with explicit limits.
not_supported: Clinical simulation superiority, equivalence to patients, or validity inherited from TLC.
source_scope: General clinical outcome assessment measurement principles; no FDA regulatory requirement is imposed on this poster project.
previous_verification_scope: Arithmetic only; historical hashes predate this validity review.
